instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedge instruments outstanding as of December 31, 2025. The fuel hedge program, suspended in Q4 2023, has fully wound down. The Derivative financial instruments accounting policy note (Note 2) references only interest rate derivatives; no fuel hedge contracts mentioned anywhere in the filing. All Hawaiian Airlines run-off positions (47M gal through Sep 2025) have also settled. Company now uses only interest rate swaps. Full-year 2025 consumption ~1,100M gal implied (includes full year of Hawaiian Airlines). Company operates Hawaiian Airlines brand post-September 2025 loyalty program merger into Atmos Rewards.
